name: lamina
description: Plan and create brand-aware AI images, video, audio, and narrated multi-shot media with approval and budget controls.

interface.longDescription: Lamina turns a creative brief into a costed, brand-aware plan for images, video, audio, or narrated multi-shot media. Review the steps and credit estimate before approving execution, then track and refine the result.
defaultPrompt: Plan a 15-second vertical launch video and wait for my approval.
Turn my product images into an on-brand social campaign.
Create a narrated multi-shot explainer from this brief.
